model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for a base model and models fine-tuned on specific medical domains. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Per-specialty terms," ordered left to right as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and features a continuous linear scale extending downwards from a visual baseline at -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom, with numeric tick labels provided at regular intervals of 1 unit. Within each horizontal category, data is visually arranged into grouped clusters of seven downward-extending bars. A legend positioned above the chart indicates the grouping methodology: the leftmost light blue bar in each cluster represents the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model, while the subsequent six bars correspond to models "Fine-tuned on:" specific domains. These fine-tuned models are delineated by a light-to-dark color gradient: Cardio (very light peach), Gastro (light orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across the chart, the light blue base model bars consistently extend furthest downward, representing the lowest negative log probabilities in each group, with the longest bar overall appearing in the Cardio term category at approximately -26.7. Conversely, the shortest downward bars appear in the Infect term category, where the fine-tuned models reach values closest to the baseline, ranging between approximately -23.0 and -23.2. The grouped bars maintain the consistent sequence dictated by the legend across all categories rather than being sorted by length or magnitude, and no single bar is uniquely emphasized with bolding, outlines, or individual annotation.
